'''Saylind Donels''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngling]] in the years around the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
He trained in the [[Bear Clan/Legends|Bear Clan]] under the guidance of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was searching for [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] location and he came to Yoda's classroom, Donels was there for his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training.
